plainTranslation: The Moon person's emotional rhythm and the Sun person's self-expression tend to cooperate naturally. This can feel familiar and calming, the kind of contact that makes harsher aspects easier to handle. Keep it active so comfort does not turn into autopilot.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
